roleTitle: Staff Development Coordinator (SDC) / Infection Control Nurse
description:
We are seeking a dedicated Staff Development Coordinator (SDC) / Infection Control Nurse to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Oakland, MD. This vital role combines the critical functions of staff education and infection prevention, ensuring our team is highly skilled and our environment is safe for all residents and staff. You will play a key role in maintaining high standards of care and compliance.

In this dual-focused position, you will be responsible for developing and implementing comprehensive training programs for nursing staff, as well as overseeing all infection control protocols. Your expertise will directly contribute to the quality of care provided and the overall health of our community. This role offers a competitive hourly rate of $40-$42.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Maryland
Experience in staff development or nursing education
Experience in infection prevention and control practices
Knowledge of state and federal regulations related to staff training and infection control
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate of $40-$42, based on experience.

description: We are seeking an experienced and dynamic Marketing Director to join a premier skilled nursing facility in Sarasota County, FL. This is an exciting opportunity to lead marketing initiatives for a recently purchased facility, contributing significantly to its growth and success. You will play a pivotal role in shaping the facility's presence and reputation within the community.The ideal candidate will be a results-driven professional with a strong ability to build relationships and drive census growth. This role offers competitive compensation for the right individual who is eager to make a significant impact. We are looking for someone who is not only presentable and professional but also possesses a proactive and energetic approach to marketing.
requirements: Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field
Proven experience as a Marketing Director, preferably within a skilled nursing or healthcare environment
Demonstrated ability to drive census growth and achieve marketing objectives
Professional demeanor and excellent communication skills
Flexibility to work occasional weekends as needed

description:
We are seeking a dedicated and compassionate Physical Therapist (PT) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Inverness, FL. This PRN (as needed) role offers flexibility while providing essential therapy services to patients.

As a Physical Therapist, you will play a crucial role in helping patients regain mobility, reduce pain, and improve their overall quality of life. You will develop and implement individualized treatment plans, collaborate with a multidisciplinary team, and contribute to a positive and supportive environment focused on patient recovery and well-being. This is an excellent opportunity for a skilled PT looking for flexible scheduling.
requirements: Current Physical Therapist (PT) license in the state of Florida
Doctorate or Master's degree in Physical Therapy from an accredited program
CPR certification
Ability to work independently and as part of a team
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: Physical Therapists can expect compensation up to $40.00 per hour.

description:

In this full-time role, you will work closely with patients to implement individualized therapy plans, helping them regain mobility and improve their quality of life. We offer a competitive hourly rate for this position, reflecting your valuable skills and commitment to patient well-being.
requirements: Current Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA) license

Ability to work full-time

salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate for Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA) is $28.00 - $37.00, based on experience.

description:
We are urgently seeking dedicated Full-time Certified Occupational Therapy Assistants (COTA) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Gainesville, FL. This is a critical opportunity to make a significant impact on patient recovery and well-being within a supportive environment.

As a COTA, you will work under the supervision of an Occupational Therapist, assisting patients in regaining independence in daily living activities. Your responsibilities will include implementing individualized treatment plans, documenting patient progress, and collaborating with a multidisciplinary team to achieve optimal outcomes. We offer a competitive hourly rate for this vital role.

If you are a compassionate and skilled COTA looking for a rewarding full-time position with immediate impact, we encourage you to apply. Join a team committed to providing exceptional patient care.
requirements: Certified Occupational Therapy Assistant (COTA) certification
Current Florida state licensure
Minimum of 1 year of experience as a COTA
salaryOrBonusInfo: Competitive hourly rate of $28.00 - $37.00, based on experience.

description:
We are seeking a dedicated School Psychologist for a contract position within a local school district in Colorado Springs, CO. This initial contract runs from July 27, 2026, for a duration of 42 weeks, offering a competitive hourly rate of $60/hr+.

In this role, you will be instrumental in supporting the academic, social, and emotional well-being of students. Responsibilities typically include conducting psychological assessments, providing counseling and intervention services, and collaborating with educators and parents to create supportive learning environments.

This is an excellent opportunity for a skilled professional to make a significant impact in a vibrant educational setting. We encourage qualified candidates to apply promptly.
requirements: Master's or Doctoral degree in School Psychology
Valid state licensure or certification as a School Psychologist
Experience working with school-aged children and adolescents
Knowledge of relevant educational laws and regulations (e.g., IDEA)
